data.narrative:
Firefly Aerospace is a public-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Tom Markusic, currently valued at approximately $2.9B following an $868M IPO. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage public comparables: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The median valuation across these three public peers is $7.6B, with a wide dispersion ranging from $840M at the low end to $40.0B at the high end. This reflects material heterogeneity in the Space & Aerospace public market, where scale and stage of commercialization vary significantly. A public-comp anchoring method using the sector's median P/S multiple of 27.4x across 6 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) cannot be applied without Firefly's reported revenue, which is not available on file.

The triangulated valuation range derived from this single applicable method is $6.4B (low), $7.6B (median), and $8.7B (high). The current trading valuation of $2.9B sits substantially below this peer-derived range. Key uncertainties include revenue visibility, the durability of near-term Space & Aerospace multiples, and whether Firefly's asset base and contract pipeline justify positioning relative to higher-valued peers or closer to the Astroscale end of the comparables spectrum.
